title: Job
description: Schema for a job to be processed by the AI worker.

schema_version.description: The version of this job schema.

document_id.description: Identifier for the document to be processed.

status.description: The current status of the job.

payload.description: Arbitrary data for the worker to use.

storage_path.description: Path to the document in storage for extraction.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the document (e.g., application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document).

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient for multi-document merge operations.

document_ids.description: Array of document IDs for multi-document processing (patient merge).

patient_identifiers.description: Patient identity matching inputs when patient_id is not supplied.

mrn.description: Medical Record Number for patient matching.

name.description: Patient name for matching (used with dob).

dob.description: Patient date of birth (ISO 8601 date format) for matching.
